title: Types of Revenue Leakage: 6 Categories That Cost Growing Businesses
description: Types of revenue leakage across acquisition, response, conversion, retention, billing, and expansion — with examples and what to fix first.

faq.q: What are the main types of revenue leakage?
faq.a: Most businesses leak in six places: acquisition, response, conversion, retention, billing/recovery, and expansion. Each type needs a different fix.

faq.q: Which type of revenue leakage is most common?
faq.a: It depends on the model. SaaS often leaks in conversion and billing; ecommerce in cart abandonment; agencies in follow-up and proposals.

faq.q: How do you prioritize types of revenue leakage?
faq.a: Estimate monthly dollars at risk for each category, then fix the highest-impact leak that you can improve within a few weeks.

blocks.text: Types of revenue leakage map cleanly to stages of the customer journey. Naming the type matters because “we need more leads” is the wrong fix if billing or retention is where the money escapes.
Traffic that never becomes a qualified lead — wrong audience, weak offer, or unclear landing pages. Fix positioning and intent match before buying more ads.

Leads go cold because follow-up is slow. Demo and pricing requests answered in days instead of hours are a classic agency and B2B leak. Related: [agency proposal leakage](/blog/agency-proposal-leakage).
Trials, demos, or carts that stall before payment. See [funnel conversion leaks](/blog/funnel-conversion-leaks) and [cart abandonment revenue leak](/blog/cart-abandonment-revenue-leak).
Customers churn early or never activate. Exit surveys and onboarding to first value usually beat discounting as a first move.

Failed payments, invoice delays, and silent involuntary churn. Start with [failed payment recovery](/blog/failed-payment-recovery) and the full [failed payment recovery guide](/guides/failed-payment-recovery).
Happy customers who would upgrade but never see a plan, usage trigger, or annual offer. Often the largest silent leak in SaaS.

For worked examples of each type, read [revenue leakage examples](/blog/revenue-leakage-examples). To score your own mix, use [revenue leakage analysis](/guides/revenue-leakage-analysis) or the free diagnostic.
